title: obione angulata
intro: Obione angulata, commonly known as Angle-leaved Sea Spurry, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Amaranthaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Obione angulata include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
